entry.name: refreshInterval
entry.label: Seconds between checks while the popup is closed.

entry.name: maxSessions
entry.label: How many sessions the popup shows before it starts scrolling. Grid units were the old unit and meant nothing to anyone reading the dialog.

entry.name: showDone
entry.label: List sessions that have finished and are waiting for a prompt.

entry.name: attentionWhenWaiting
entry.label: Mark the widget as needing attention while a session is blocked.

entry.name: showTotal
entry.label: Show the session count beside the bars in the panel.

entry.name: countScale
entry.label: Size of the session count, as a percentage of its natural size.

entry.name: panelUsage
entry.label: Show a bar under the session bars for the selected plan limit.

entry.name: panelUsageThreshold
entry.label: Only show that bar once this much of the limit is used; 0 is always.

entry.name: panelUsageColour
entry.label: Colour that bar by how much of the limit is gone, as the popup does.

entry.name: customColors
entry.label: Use the colours below instead of the built-in ones.

entry.name: branchSeparate
entry.label: Give the branch its own row instead of appending it to the repository.

entry.name: shortLabels
entry.label: Abbreviate Directory and Repository to Dir and Repo.

entry.name: showUsage
entry.label: Show each profile's plan usage under the session list.

entry.name: usageProfile
entry.label: Which account's usage bar shows while the selector is collapsed, as its config directory. Blank, or one that is no longer configured, falls back to the first.

entry.name: profileSearchPath
entry.label: Where the Accounts page looks when asked to search. Searching is always a deliberate act: an account removed from the list has to stay removed across restarts, which it cannot if something re-runs the search on its own.

entry.name: censorNames
entry.label: Blank out session names and their second line.

entry.name: nicknames
entry.label: Widget-local session names, as a JSON object keyed by session id.
